title: High-signal generic assignments: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic literals assigned to `api_key`, `password` and similar names, and a twin of the same value under a non-credential name such as `build_id`. Covers 2 inputs.
rationale: With no provider format, the assignment name is the signal. The twin proves the name, not the value's shape alone, decides.

expectation.rationale: Independently authored public conformance row for the bounded credential project-policy contract.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Imported as a draft from the legacy suite "Public policy qualification controls for bounded T3 credentials (#365)" (policy-qualified-credentials); not yet reviewed.
